footnote_text: On October 14, 2026 (the "Grant Date"), Mr. David was granted two hundred fifty thousand (250,000) Restricted Stock Units ("RSUs") under the Actinium Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 2026 Employment Inducement Award Plan (the "Inducement Plan"). One hundred twenty-five thousand (125,000) RSUs shall vest in three (3) equal installments on each of the first, second, and third anniversaries of the Grant Date, subject to Mr. David's continuing service to the Issuer on each the applicable vesting date. One hundred twenty-five thousand (125,000) RSUs shall vest in full on the third (3rd) anniversary of the Grant Date, subject to Mr. David's continuing service to the Issuer on the applicable vesting date.
